digest.component_or_area: review-bot event store and clone reconciliation
propositions: Two untracked event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot clone that predate the A6-0b deployment and are not committed to the authoritative tickets branch.
The first file is a superseded unsigned derived-cache TICKET_DIGEST sidecar for ticket 172e-b207-4c18-4243 that is not authoritative because newer committed digests exist for the same ticket.
The second file is an expired CLAIM_ENRICH queue entry for ticket 7ab3-9df0-7a90-4ffd with a lease that expired before inspection and was superseded by later claim and done events.
Both stranded files are disposable residue rather than unique canonical events and can be safely deleted without loss of authoritative data.

The persistent clone must be cleaned to have no untracked event files and verified to have HEAD equal to refs/remotes/origin/tickets with no merge, rebase, or stash state before the A6-1 publication window.
